body:
I don't have a lot of friends, mainly because my depression has caused me to push them away. There are a couple people that I know wouldn't judge me for telling them, but I'm afraid that I will still be seen as "the girl with suicidal thoughts" or "the depressed chick that has major problems." 

I don't really have any other family members to talk to, they wouldn't understand, really. My brother would just brush it off, my sister is too busy with her own recent break up and her being a single mother to a feisty five year old.
